name: Nike Dunk Low Retro QS 'Argon' 2022
story_html: The 2022 edition of the Nike Dunk Low Retro QS ‘Argon’ brings back a coveted CO.JP colorway that launched exclusively in Japan in 2001. The smooth leather upper combines a marine blue foundation with powder blue overlays and a crisp white Swoosh. A woven Nike tag adorns the breathable nylon tongue, while the white leather back tab displays a Nike wordmark in slanted block lettering. The sneaker rests on a standard rubber cupsole, featuring white sidewalls and a pastel blue outsole.
